commands.name: studio_character_suggestion_result

commands.name: studio_accept_character_suggestion

commands.name: studio_generate_voice_library
commands.description: Generate 1–12 French reference phrases with installed VoxCPM2 from a prepared character source. Returns job ID, reuses model during this batch and releases it at end/cancellation. Samples are PENDING: audition and require explicit human approval before review/default use. Never replaces dialogue takes.

commands.name: studio_review_voice_library_sample
commands.description: Approve, withdraw, reject, correct actual transcript or choose an approved default for a character French phrase. Approval/default must follow explicit human selection; generation does not certify quality. Correcting the transcript revokes approval. Existing files/takes remain. Returns project.

commands.name: studio_voice_library_audio_path
commands.description: Read the local WAV path of a source or sample belonging to a character, for audition. Does not approve it.

commands.name: studio_prepare_character_reference
commands.description: Prepare a new 1–20 second mono WAV by trimming/concatenating 1–16 existing reference segments. Does not change the project; use the returned VoiceReference with studio_merge_characters. Original reference files are retained. Partial segments require transcript review.

commands.name: studio_preview_character_sample
commands.description: Render a bounded (maximum 20 seconds) dialogue excerpt from the chosen track including its edits, before track mute/solo/global fader. Returns a local WAV path; never changes source audio or the project.

commands.name: studio_separate_audio_region

Requires the existing speech/music/effects stem tracks. Poll jobs, read studio_local_separation_result and audition its three WAVs before explicit application.

Replaces all three stem regions when the source is Original; for a stem source, replaces that stem region and adds the other recovered components to their tracks. Source files, other times and historical takes are retained.

builtins.name: studio_get_state
builtins.description: Read project identity/revision, selection, playback, jobs and UI preferences. Read this before an edit and pass its context to mutations.

builtins.name: studio_voice_quality_catalog
builtins.description: Read supported generation quality controls, bounds, defaults and model-specific presets. Apply quality in VoiceSettings for single or batch generation. Existing takes are preserved.

builtins.name: studio_audio_levels
builtins.description: Read live stereo sample-peak/RMS dBFS levels after track gain, regions and effects, before player listening volume. $mix is the summed final mix before export clipping. Reset clears latched clipping and maxima for one track ID or all tracks when id is omitted. This never changes project audio or gain.

builtins.name: studio_get_project
builtins.description: Read the complete saved project JSON. For partial changes prefer the typed editing tools or atomic project patches.

builtins.name: studio_get_dialogues
builtins.description: Read paginated dialogue texts, translation statuses, selected takes and timing. Maximum 200 rows per response.

builtins.name: studio_microphone
builtins.description: Record a local microphone take for a dialogue in the open studio. status/start/stop/discard/save. start may require the Windows microphone permission prompt; max 120 seconds. save adds an immutable take. Existing takes stay intact.

builtins.name: studio_save
builtins.description: Flush pending desktop edits to disk. No project change is discarded.

builtins.name: studio_project_patch
builtins.description: Atomically apply JSON Pointer patches to the current project with validation and undo. add/replace/remove/test supported; Project identity/revision/creation metadata cannot be overwritten. Use test for array IDs. All character, reference, pronunciation, model, subtitle, track and lip settings are editable. Read studio://schemas/Project for the full schema.

builtins.name: studio_edit_dialogue
builtins.description: Edit source/translated/spoken text; optionally validate the translation. lineId must exist.

builtins.name: studio_add_dialogue
builtins.description: Add a timed dialogue with optional original or translated text (at least one nonempty). Creates independent SRT cues without moving existing lines. Context required; undoable. Read studio_get_project to retrieve its new ID.

builtins.name: studio_set_dialogue_exclusion
builtins.description: Exclude or restore dialogues for dubbing. Preserve source/translated subtitles, every historical take, voice edit and placement. Excluded lines stay outside voice mixing, generation and lip batches. Undoable; unknown IDs reject atomically.

builtins.name: studio_approve_translations
builtins.description: Approve or withdraw the common text and selected-current-voice review for supplied dialogue IDs in one undoable saved edit. Empty translations and stale selected takes are skipped; unknown IDs reject the entire edit. Without a selected take, approve text for batch preparation; a new selected take withdraws that approval. Any text, pronunciation, take, edit or placement change withdraws the common approval. Historical takes are preserved. Read checkedIds from studio_get_state to include checked lines hidden by filters.

builtins.name: studio_set_character_profile
builtins.description: Edit manual gender/temporary-name metadata or a confirmed thumbnail. Gender is explicitly user-provided, never inferred from face or voice.

builtins.name: studio_merge_characters
builtins.description: Merge selected character profiles into keepId as one undoable edit. Retains all reference files and historical voice takes; reassigns dialogues. Optionally use a prepared composite reference or select a different default reference and portrait.

builtins.name: studio_apply_speaker_analysis
builtins.description: Apply the current reviewed voice grouping proposals. Respects its recorded section, audio snapshot and replaceAssigned setting; preserves existing assignments by default. Creates temporary names for unknown groups and reuses the guided reference character.

builtins.name: studio_retime_dialogue
builtins.description: Set subtitle timing for source, target or both without moving other lines.

builtins.name: studio_split_dialogue
builtins.description: Split a subtitle dialogue at a time in milliseconds.

builtins.name: studio_merge_dialogue
builtins.description: Merge a dialogue with its following dialogue.

builtins.name: studio_move_voice
builtins.description: Move the selected generated voice relative to its dialogue. Offset is signed milliseconds. Rejects overlaps and film boundaries.

builtins.name: studio_resize_voice
builtins.description: Change the generated voice duration while preserving pitch, within the actual free timeline slot.

builtins.name: studio_edit_voice
builtins.description: Cut, add silence, stretch, set gain, apply fades or replace an audio effects chain on a generated take. Its original WAV is preserved. Render is checked before committing.

builtins.name: studio_set_track
builtins.description: Change track mute, solo and global gain independently. Global gains range from zero to four (0–400%), independently of region gains.

builtins.name: studio_audio_region
builtins.description: Paint a gain/mute interval on any audio track, preserving surrounding portions.

builtins.name: studio_remove_audio_region
builtins.description: Remove a saved gain/mute region on an audio track.

builtins.name: studio_set_all_audio
builtins.description: Quickly mute or unmute all audio, or one track when trackId is provided.

builtins.name: studio_select_take
builtins.description: Choose a generated voice take for playback and export.

builtins.name: studio_delete_take
builtins.description: Remove a take from the project; native source files are never overwritten by this edit. Undo remains available.

builtins.name: studio_review_take
builtins.description: Validate or invalidate a dialogue voice take.

builtins.name: studio_set_lip_variant
builtins.description: Enable or disable a retouched clip after checking that it matches the current voice and timing.

builtins.name: studio_select_dialogue
builtins.description: Select and reveal a dialogue in the desktop timeline.

builtins.name: studio_set_selection
builtins.description: Check a list of dialogue IDs for a batch. This replaces the current checked list.

builtins.name: studio_playback
builtins.description: Control synchronized playback, original/generated replies or an isolated audio selection. action=selection requires trackId/startMs/endMs and optionally beforeLevels to bypass track and selection volume/mute without saving changes. Selection stops at its end; pause/stop cancels it. Times are milliseconds.

builtins.name: studio_preferences
builtins.description: Control interface language/theme, selected panel, loop padding and timeline zoom. No arbitrary code or shell commands.

builtins.name: studio_updates
builtins.description: Read or check for an app update, start its signed download, change automatic checks, or install a downloaded update. Install requires all processing jobs to finish, saves the project and restarts the app. Download/install return accepted status; poll studio_get_state.updater.
